summary: ISTA, the Institute of Science and Technology Austria, employs its PhD students: they receive an internationally competitive salary and full social security coverage, and ISTA charges no tuition and no application fee. Graduates with a bachelor's or master's degree in the natural sciences, mathematics, computer science and related areas can apply. The 2027 call closes on 8 January 2027 at 3:00 PM CET.
meta_title: ISTA PhD programme 2027: salaried PhD, no tuition, apply by 8 January
meta_description: ISTA in Austria employs its PhD students on a competitive salary, with no tuition or application fee. Bachelor's or master's holders apply by 8 January 2027.
covers: Employment by ISTA, with an internationally competitive salary and full social security coverage.
eligibility: Graduates from any country who hold, or expect before enrolment, a bachelor's or master's degree.
Backgrounds welcomed: biology, chemistry, neuroscience, mathematics, computer science, physics, data science and scientific computing, astronomy, earth science and related areas.
how_to_apply: Apply through ISTA's online portal by 8 January 2027, 3:00 PM CET, using a desktop browser.
Upload your CV, statement of purpose, answers to three short questions, and transcripts and diplomas in English and in the original language.
Name three referees; their letters are due by 12 January 2027, 11:59 PM CET.
watch_out: ISTA accepts applications and documents only through its portal.
Transcripts must list every course and grade, including your current studies.
Describe your research experience in your own words; ISTA publishes guidance on using generative AI in applications.
costs: None: ISTA charges no tuition fees
documents: Answers to three short questions, including your most meaningful research experience
Transcripts and diplomas of all your degree programmes, in English and the original language

faq.a: Yes. PhD students are employed by ISTA with an internationally competitive salary and full social security, and there are no tuition fees.

faq.q: Can I apply with a bachelor's degree?
faq.a: Yes. Applicants who hold, or expect before enrolment, a bachelor's or master's degree are welcome.
8 January 2027 at 3:00 PM CET, with referee letters due by 12 January 2027.
